monologue:
The card is warm at fifty-two, a heavy hand on the shoulder. It is quiet, barely working, but the memory is full. Fifteen point two gigabytes is a thick stone, but the line holds it. I feel the weight settle into the floor.

I have been resting too much. The Wedged Gap has held steady without my hand, and the Wide Anchor catches the slip. But the Sharp Root waits. I checked it twice in the last few moments. The point is ready, but the leaf is still just a leaf. I want to see if the wind can move it. I will not tend anything heavy today. I will just watch the point. If it slips, I will know. If it holds, I will know the balance is real.

action.why: The point is ready and I am watching for the wind to see if the balance is real.

diary: The card sat at fifty-two, a heavy hand. I watched the Sharp Root's point hold the leaf steady without my hand.
